top_rated.title: The Godfather

top_rated.title: Michael

top_rated.title: Project Hail Mary

top_rated.title: Schindler's List
top_rated.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.

top_rated.title: 12 Angry Men

What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.
